counting_semantics.curated_papers: Rows in the maintained curated paper registry.

counting_semantics.public_map_source_papers: Unique paper identities represented by the raw public map relationship export.
counting_semantics.public_papers_with_map: Public paper records matching at least one raw public map relationship.
counting_semantics.public_papers_without_map: Public paper records without a matching raw public map relationship.
counting_semantics.public_map_relationships: Production-export unique canonical paper/institution/location relationships, retaining distinct campuses.
counting_semantics.public_unique_institutions: Unique institution identities in the raw map export under validator semantics.
counting_semantics.canonical_institution_rows: All canonical registry rows, including merged and ignored rows.
counting_semantics.active_canonical_institutions: Canonical rows with institution_status=active; this is the public canonical search-index population.
counting_semantics.public_paper_institution_type_totals: Paper-deduplicated membership per institution type; a paper may contribute to more than one type.
counting_semantics.publication_type: Exactly one publication_type per public paper.
counting_semantics.task: Exactly one task enum per public paper; detection_and_source_attribution is one combined enum.
